decision: Keep all four terminal models offline. Printed-only continuation is worth further component evaluation, but synthetic gains do not establish improved legal template recovery and real print/smooth-curve failures persist.

verification.scope: Independent maximum-flow corner matching against the evaluation Hungarian scorer, all raw/refined/readout pairs. Reference/validity arrays, training schedule, BN buffers and summaries checked. Does not repeat model inference or independently score photographic accuracy.

diagnosis.selection: Post-hoc: largest raw-original loss per arm and largest printed gain, already fixed by evaluation report. No training or threshold changes.

observations: All two input pages, six selected synthetic pages and eleven real pages were inspected.
On pale synthetic printed stock, the unchanged classifier can follow decorative flowers instead of the paper cells. The physical boundary/corner target remains unchanged.
Printed-only training restores two faint corners in channel-832113-v1 that plain continuation misses; some development views lose visible boundary coverage.
Real printed/combined predictions suppress some dot and floral proposals but still trace letters, trees and floral ink. This is not successful paper-identity recognition.
Smooth real heart lobes, petals, crescents and animal silhouettes retain many spurious corner proposals. Some intended fine silhouette details also lose proposals.
The same six unresolved crops and the known packaging/reflection/background crop failures remain; this experiment does not change the cropper.

interpretation: The matched plain continuation already improves channel/frame corner scores. Do not attribute that entire gain to augmentation.
At the fixed operating point, printed-only improves boundary F1 versus the plain control on all three synthetic cohorts, but raw corner F1 and complete-corner coverage do not improve uniformly.
Phase-only raises real cross-phase agreement from the prior 83.85% to 87.16%; consistency is not labelled accuracy.

The largest combined regression keeps local peaks near both correct corners but lowers them to 0.3696 and 0.2334, below the frozen 0.4 threshold. Other largest losses shift peaks just beyond the 3px match radius. Exact replay rules out changed crops, labels or scoring inputs.

These are single-seed, fixed-threshold findings. No checkpoint/threshold was selected from evaluation. They do not prove augmentation is intrinsically worse under a separately calibrated operating point.
nextSteps: Measure printed-paper transfer on the 21 excluded procedural variants without admitting their seven development designs to training.
Broaden procedural training to smooth silhouettes with sparse true corners, while preserving fine motif features and photo source splits.
Evaluate candidate proposals through graph construction and legal-template recovery before any production model replacement.
limitations: No new original-artwork or real-corner ground truth.
Reused synthetic recipe evaluations are not topology-disjoint holdouts.
No ONNX export, browser inference or full template fitting in this experiment.
Production models, solver settings and geometry/paper acceptance gates unchanged.
